title: Hostinger completed Node.js build log evidence

phases.objective: Read one completed Hostinger Node.js build log through the official authenticated GET endpoint and extract bounded source SHA, Production branch, and release-directory evidence without provider mutation.

e2e_journeys.actor: trusted release operator and GitHub Actions
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Hostinger Node.js Completed Build Log Evidence workflow contract test or trusted workflow dispatch from main
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A secret-free JSON and Markdown artifact identifies whether the completed build log exposes the expected Production SHA, another SHA, only a Production branch hint, or no source provenance.
steps: Validate account, fixed auth.mad4b.com domain, exact build UUID, and exact expected Production SHA.
Build the official Hostinger completed-build logs URL with encoded path parameters.
Perform exactly one authenticated GET request using HOSTINGER_API_TOKEN.
Bound the provider response before parsing.
Extract SHA, Production branch, and release-path hints without persisting the bearer token.
Persist a redacted log excerpt no longer than 12000 characters.
Upload structured evidence before enforcing the decision.
assertions: The exact token is absent from JSON, Markdown, errors, and console summaries.
Expected SHA in logs passes; another SHA fails; branch-only and source-unverified results remain partial.
No build creation, deployment, release activation, restart, provider mutation, repository mutation, SQL, migration Apply, database mutation, or external send occurs.

phases.objective: Dispatch the merged workflow against build UUID 019fc51c-3947-7255-aa4d-f55cb8df7658 and Production f5c1ae8840b4d4452f2908bb0f23051880bb6896.
